verdict.rationale: Linear is a SaaS product with built-in AI features (Linear Agent, Loops), so an AI-training opt-out is a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack contains no documented setting, policy, or guarantee that customer data is excluded from AI model training. A community comment about the generic Terms of Service content license is a concern, not a documented opt-out capability, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
